notes.title: Souper Game’s Steam page turns 1 year old today!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/0f31a80776a15e4cec740af34a1243f936122b6f.png"][/img][/p][p]Development started in spring 2024, it was exactly one year ago that we first showed the game to the world. We’re still working hard on the project and by the end of 2025 the soup will be served hot!  Over this year the game has been wishlisted 25000 times. Our team wants to thank each and every one of you who supports us: those who added the game to their wishlist, leave comments and reviews, test the demo and simply believe in our project! <3[/p][p][/p][p]And now go to the news:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/05f6f5bf7c585fb3dc13c00328d979330f41f622.png"][/img][/p][p]At the moment we’re working on three of the final story events in the game. They packed with animations so the process is taking some time. According to our current estimates, the story will be fully drawn and written in the end of September and after that I’ll start working on the gameplay and game ending... It will take time too. Just a reminder — finishing the story art doesn’t mean the game is done. There’s still gameplay, interfaces and many other things left. So the release is still planned for the end of this year.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/68500be4160d2d9c6db43b4e564bf70db7efb6ac.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/ca1d5a13949fab0de4473b045245986c88a5488e.png"][/img]  [/p][p]The second boss is almost ready for internal testing. She is more complex and time-consuming than we expected, since she will feature a full-fledged mechanic from another game. The things we do to surprise the player, right? ;)[/p][p]The soundtrack and visuals for the third boss are currently in the works. I asked the composer to create something truly powerful and energetic. Let’s see what he comes up with! ^_^[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/73fdcade53039f5a64a2ae2a3e53e47cfe822482.png"][/img]  [/p][p]That’s all for now, don’t miss the next batch of hot news![/p]

notes.title: Major Souper Game Demo Update for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
The game keeps evolving!
The gameplay is now even more fun and dynamic and the elf girl is sassier, chattier and still hot as always...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/e8e4e175e306baa0cd436e3c1542b2168048daa7.png[/img]

[b]Changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] A story event with yoga. You will like it... ;)
[*] A story event with soap bubbles.
[*] The elf girl is now more talkative. Added comments after level completion, unique comforting lines for losses and some jokes with hints.
[*] A secret mini-boss...
[*] Three new soundtracks for story events.
[*] Encyclopedia button (just the button for now, without the actual encyclopedia).
[*] Control hints in the menu.
[*] New visual effects from dancing enemies.
[*] Three new items for the top fridge shelf. I'm sure you'll love them!
[*] Four new skins for the snail. She can finally change her home!
[*] Reworked ice cream mini-game. New mechanics — simpler, fairer and easier to understand.
[*] Completely updated English translation.
[*] Boss death animation improved.
[*] The bee has been fixed. It no longer dies from a closed lid, reclaiming its title as the most annoying enemy!
[*] New tutorial elements.
[*] Minor bug fixes and tweaks.
[/list]
The elf girl's comments between levels are still in test mode and your feedback is really important to us! ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/4425f666a27552c27c2b585e5e53510da5dc0f25.png[/img]

notes.title: Updated demo with Streamer Mode is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/37a60bc5696a33854465b99629d807943935e994.jpg[/img]
We are participating in the Igroprom competition, so we decided to release a demo with the updated gameplay, without new story scenes yet but with an optional Streamer Mode, so content creators can already stream the new demo.
The story-expanded demo will arrive within a month! 😄

What’s new:

1. Updated gameplay! It’s now less boring and much more varied.

2. A spicy new mini-game with the elf girl! Currently available from the start, though in the future it will unlock after defeating the boss.

3. New enemy tier! Scarab creeps, ninja bugs, and creepy-crawly bugchicks — all ready to ruin your day or eat you alive.

4. New items! Some are hilariously useless, others — incredibly valuable.

5. Auto-clicker added as a standalone skill in the upgrade tree.

6. Dialogues updated to be more coherent and funny.

7. Streamer Mode can now be enabled via settings or a separate screen at the start of the game.

8. Final demo screen includes spoilers for upcoming game events.

9. Teaser of the second boss.

10. New soundtrack specially composed for the intro.

11. New interactive zones, more easter eggs and fresh sound effects.

12. Three new skills to upgrade

13. random encounters and animations for them

14. Overall smoothness and convenience

notes.title: Souper Game collector’s edition!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/278437313bd57390a9aa7766e920fbe9f58dc0cd.jpg[/img]

A collector’s edition of our game will be released, featuring elven panties and a figurine of the Souper Game heroine!

Previously, I showed you a 3D model of our elf, but never explained why...

And now… Boo! Scared? Don’t be! It’s just the collector’s edition of Souper Game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/e55b0c187d42af5d2a72b3085d91a44d3ea9a0ea.jpg[/img]

The figurine is hand-painted by a loving elven hand. I personally pulled her ears—they’re real, I checked.

Elven panties… with the scent of our soup, mmm… 

And the super-secret soup recipe, written on parchment. It’s so secret that you’ll have to burn it after reading!

And for the most dedicated fans—an artbook filled with style guides, revealing all the hidden secrets of the characters, apartment, and world of the game. You’ll discover things about our heroes that you never even imagined! (Including the mystery of why the troll doesn’t wear underwear)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/69d4a9c7c7e88009d842834b6debe3f04956365a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The first News of the year!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've reached 10,000 wishlists on Steam, friends! This number feels huge to me and I’m very happy that I’ve managed to get you interested in a game about... a living soup ^_^

Right now our team is focused on build the prototype of the updated gameplay. We added new enemies, new items and a new hot minigame with our elf girl. As you already know the game is now arcade-style and it's mean that you won’t have to start from the first level if you lose, just from the current one. All these changes will be part of the next extended demo which we are planning to release this spring.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/6134d90664549e59a2cd519a0faf8a79cf00e269.png[/img]
Even though our powers are concentrated on gameplay because it's the most critical part of the game right now, we haven’t forgotten about the story. We making art and text at full speed and we’re already nearing half of the planned content. Once we finish the gameplay we will shift our focus to integrating the story into the game. A small piece of the new story will also be included in the updated demo this spring.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/377d16091ea4a82f43ca9ccc656231455a6d91d3.jpg[/img]
That’s all for now! Stay tuned for more updates! Thank you for your warm feedback, advice and support ^_^ it’s helping us make the game better ;)

notes.title: Souper Game Development News
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/0fd6233c5d7916254554185fef1e84ff6f2599dc.png[/img]
Hello everyone! It’s been a month since the demo was released, and I’d like to share some development news.
Gameplay: We decided to change the balance a bit and shift the gameplay from a roguelike mechanic to a more arcade-style. And now players will progress through levels and upon death, you’ll only need to restart the current level rather than the entire gameplay.
The levels become longer and more diverse. New special types of enemies will appear sometimes. Rare items will also be introduced—both highly useful and harmful. These items are optional and sometimes it might be better to discard them ;)
We’ve added more variety by introducing three new items per tier. Currently, I made nine types of vegetables, fruits, and meats—not counting the special items with cool effects.
Story: We decided to reduce the number of story events from 18 to 15, but make them more engaging and diverse. At this moment 7 out of 15 story events have been drawn and scripted into the dialogues.
Based on feedback from polls, we learned that jokes about the Troll can include elements of dark humor. In some story actions we’re inspired by "Tom and Jerry" and I think some situations will really surprise you :)
Mini-games with Sylvie: I’ve drawn 3 out of 5 mini-games featuring the elf girl. And now we have:
- Lollipop;
- Ice cream;
- Whipped cream with strawberries.
Animations for them are still in progress.
That’s all now! Don’t miss more exciting news!

notes.title: Demo is here!
notes.content:
We’ve carefully listened to your feedback and improved everything we could to make the game even more fun and convenient to play.

For those who tried the previous version on Itch, here’s what awaits you in the new version:

[olist]
[*] The Troll comes with surprises: Not only does he eat your soup, but he also has something unexpected up his sleeve each time. Losing isn’t so bad anymore!
[*] Spacebar clicks? Easy! Now you can either click with the mouse or press the spacebar to attack enemies and progress through dialogues.
[*] Heart-spending tutorial: Sylvie will guide you on how to use this crucial resource effectively.
[*] Convenience for everyone: Adjustable window sizes in dialogues, tailored for those playing on mobile devices.
[*] Progress bar: You can now see how close you are to your next level-up. No more confusion!
[*] The Troll appears sooner after level 5: Saving you time—less waiting, more action!
[*] The boss has moved to the end of level 19: He’s ready to surprise you from his new position.
[*] Boss animation: Starting at level 16, you’ll get a taste of what’s waiting for you at level 19. Two stages of tension-packed fun!
[*] Effects and tips: The mechanics of items and enemies are now clearer thanks to new visual cues.
[/olist]

I’d greatly appreciate your suggestions and ideas in the dedicated discussion section for the game. ;)

notes.title: First 1000 wishlists on Steam!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We've got tons of fresh updates on Souper Game, and we can't wait to share them with you!

First off, we’re thrilled to announce that we’ve surpassed 1,000 wishlists on Steam! This is absolutely incredible, and we’re so grateful to everyone who added the game to their wishlist. Your support is our biggest source of motivation!

Secondly, we’ve finally completed the third prototype of the demo, and it’s now fully playable. The difficulty balance is all set, with just a few minor tweaks left. In total, we’ve identified and nearly fixed 119 bugs. The game will soon be ready for the first closed tests—we’re so excited!

Another cool update: the main room has finally come to life—now all animations and sounds are working, and you can interact with almost every object! The immersion is going to be top-notch.

The story is progressing as well: all the demo texts have been translated into English and are already in the game. We’ve spent a lot of time on the dialogues to make every character more unique and expressive. We hope you’ll love how they interact!

There’s progress on the sound front too—all UI sounds are done, and we’ve finished the audio for the story scenes. We just need to add sounds for the minigames and a couple of missing ones. Plus, the music is fully integrated into the demo, so the soundtrack is ready to shine.

Stay tuned—there’s a lot more exciting stuff coming soon!

notes.title: Some news!
notes.content:

Last week I was busy working on the story part for the demo and it's almost finished. The story is turning out to be fun and full of spicy situations... All that's left are some final touches and the interfaces for the demo. The last missing soundtrack has been written and the sound effects for the intro are completed.
